timing.utc_limitation: Host UTC is an observation timestamp, not simulator-authored UTC.

channels.name: timestamp
channels.limitation: Host observation UTC is recorded separately and is not simulator UTC.

channels.name: brake
channels.limitation: The SDK unit token is a percent symbol while the variable description defines a 0-to-1 fraction; the recorder stores the raw fraction.

channels.name: throttle
channels.limitation: The SDK unit token is a percent symbol while the variable description defines a 0-to-1 fraction; the recorder stores the raw fraction.

channels.name: steering_angle
channels.limitation: The sign convention is a declaration, not something the variable table proves; a live rehearsal must confirm it.

channels.name: speed
channels.limitation: Described by the SDK as GPS vehicle speed; a ground speed, not a wheel-rotation measurement.

channels.name: gear
channels.limitation: Forward gear count is car-dependent; gear indices are not comparable across cars.

channels.name: longitudinal_acceleration
channels.limitation: Includes gravity, so surface gradient contributes to the measured value.

channels.name: lateral_acceleration
channels.limitation: Includes gravity, so banking contributes to the measured value.

channels.name: wheel_state
channels.limitation: iRacing exposes no per-wheel rotational speed, angular velocity or slip ratio. Suspension and brake-line evidence is not wheel state.

channels.name: tire_state
channels.source: carcass temperature, tread wear, cold pressure, odometer and compound variables
channels.limitation: Cold pressure is not live pressure: the coldPressure variables are garage-set and iRacing exposes no hot or running tire pressure. Wear is percent tread remaining. Compound is a car-dependent index.

channels.name: fuel
channels.limitation: Fuel volume, not mass; iRacing does not expose fuel density.

channels.name: setup
channels.limitation: iRacing exposes no suspension geometry, spring, damper, aerodynamic, differential or gearing variable. Partial configuration is declared in configuration-setup.json.

channels.name: assists
channels.limitation: Car- and session-dependent. A setting is not an intervention: dcABS is what the driver selected, BrakeABSactive is what the system did. Absence or inactivity is not proof the car lacks the assist. SteeringFFBEnabled is rig context, not a vehicle assist.

channels.name: damage
channels.limitation: iRacing exposes no vehicle damage-state variable. PitRepairLeft, PitOptRepairLeft, FastRepairUsed and PlayerCarTowTime are repair and tow timers, not a damage model.

channels.name: flags
channels.limitation: Raw values only. Enumeration meaning is declared in recorder-metadata.json enum_dictionaries; where a dictionary is unavailable the raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted. PitsOpen is current-player scope.

channels.name: weather
channels.limitation: Measured at the start/finish line: a single-point measurement, never a track-wide field or a per-corner condition. Skies is a category index. WeatherDeclaredWet is a steward declaration about tire eligibility, not a meteorological measurement.

channels.name: traffic
channels.limitation: Privacy-minimal proximity only: no opponent identity, no car index and no per-opponent array. Nearest car only, so a multi-car pack is not described. CarLeftRight is an irsdk_CarLeftRight enumeration.

channels.name: track_conditions
channels.limitation: TrackTempCrew is measured by the crew around the track, not per-point. TrackWetness is the average surface wetness and cannot represent a single wet corner. Track location and material are neither weather nor a condition score. The deprecated TrackTemp is deliberately not read.

car_left_right.limitation: Alongside indicator. The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted. Alongside and overlap states cannot be decoded from this bundle alone.

pace_mode.limitation: The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted.

session_flags.limitation: Raw session flag bitfield. The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted. Green, yellow, checkered and pacing state cannot be decoded from this bundle alone.

session_state.limitation: The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted.

skies_index.limitation: Taken from the iRacing variable description for Skies. It is a category, not an ordinal scale. Values outside this table are preserved verbatim and carry no declared meaning.

tire_compound.limitation: Compound index is car- and content-dependent; there is no global compound scale. The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted.

track_surface.limitation: Declared by Apex Sim Coach and already used by production lap and corner analysis. Values outside this table are preserved verbatim and carry no declared meaning.

track_surface_material.limitation: The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted.

track_wetness.limitation: Average track surface wetness. The authoritative iRacing enumeration is not vendored in this repository, so no value meaning is declared. The raw value is preserved verbatim and must not be interpreted.

high_rate_360hz.reason: The 18 count-6 _ST channels declare a 360 Hz rate but prove no element ordering, no per-element timestamp, no relationship to the SDK tick and no dropped-tick behaviour. Sub-sample timestamps are not fabricated.
